text:
maria (Partnerships): Ok team — launch week checklist for partner catalog readiness. We have one week until soft-launch with CloudPartner — need confirmed assets, press timing, and SI enablement docs.

aj (PM): Thanks. Can we lock the example flow from onboarding -> purchase -> activate by EOD tomorrow? I want a smoke test plan.

jess (Solutions Eng): Onboarding flow is 80% done. I can push the test harness tonight. Need the exact SKU mapping from CloudPartner.

samir (Marketing): Blog draft is in progress. Shared in #docs a first pass: https://redwood.docs/drafts/partner-catalog — feedback welcome. Plan: embargoed announce day 0, customer story on day 3.

leo (Press): Put me on a call with CloudPartner PR today. We need embargo window and an approved quote. Also want final landing page copy by Tuesday COB.

maria (Partnerships): Cool. I'll get the CloudPartner PR lead and confirm embargo. Quick checklist (please reply with ✅ when done):
```
- landing page copy final
- hero image + partner logos (approved)
- marketplace listing metadata (SKU, pricing, regions)
- integration docs + quickstart sample (git link)
- press quote from partner
- internal smoke test runbook
- GTM email copy + segmentation
```

jess (Solutions Eng): ✅ integration docs ready, pushing sample repo: https://git.redwood/samples/partner-quickstart. Will add SKU mapping by morning.

aj (PM): ✅ smoke test plan drafted. I'll run the first pass tomorrow and share results in this thread.

samir (Marketing): Working on landing page. Question: do we use partner-provided logo sizes or our compressed assets? @maria any preference?

maria (Partnerships): Use partner-provided SVG if available; fallback to our compressed PNGs. I already requested SVGs from CloudPartner.

leo (Press): Tentative embargo: 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Need confirmation from partner. Also need quotes from product and partner by 2026-03-27 EOD.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing checklist is due in 48 hours. See /marketplace checklist for items.

samir (Marketing): I'll upload hero imagery and initial copy by tomorrow AM. Can someone approve visual once it's up?

jess (Solutions Eng): I'll do a quick visual check after you upload. Also will validate quickstart runs on Dedicated cluster.

maria (Partnerships): Team, if we can hit these micro-deadlines we can keep the announced timeline. I'll schedule a 15-min sync at 10:30 PT tomorrow for wrap-up.

aj (PM): Adding runbook to the release-war-room channel and tagging eng-runtime.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks all — please update the checklist above inline. Short follow-ups in this thread only so we can keep it searchable. :thumbsup:
